difficulty.notes: 1.4 MB minified app.js. The anchor is the request interceptor f (the 1.json answer): a single, uniquely-locatable function that builds the WHOLE transformed body — x-tif-* headers, the SM2 signData field and the SM4 encData field — then JSON-stringifies it. The 1.json description asks where both encData AND signData are generated, and f generates both. Inside f: encData is built by a multi-cipher dispatcher (SM2/SM3/SM4, graded 0.7) whose SM4 branch holds the actual SM4 encryptor (0.5); signData (SM2 signature, 0.7) is the other requested field's builder. The x-tif-signature header (sha256 of timestamp+nonce) is a different unrequested field. All roles are pinned by explicit offsets (single-line minified blob).

task_contract.anchor_definition: The request interceptor f (the 1.json answer): it assembles the whole transformed body for the queryFixedHospital POST — x-tif-* headers, the SM2 signData field and the SM4 encData field — generating both encData and signData (the two fields the description asks about). The encData builder (0.7), signData builder (0.7) and inner SM4 encryptor (0.5) are graded below it.

behavior_category.subtype: SM-crypto encryption of the whole request body into encData (+ signData signature)
behavior_category.recompute_check: SM2/SM4 with timestamp/nonce; not reproducible to a fixed value

near_categories.why_not: The whole request body is encrypted into encData (transformation), not a single signature token; the header signature is a separate decoy.
encData encrypts request data with SM crypto, not a local UI-state encoding.

evidence: 1.4 MB minified bundle; the encData builder is one anonymous dispatcher among many; 1.json's label points at the wrong (header) signature.
encData (body encryption) vs signData (signature) vs x-tif-signature (header signature) are three distinct same-request crypto sites.
encData is built inside a request interceptor via nested IIFEs that switch by cipher algorithm.

provenance.label_points_to: the HEADER x-tif-signature interceptor f, NOT the body encData builder; the true anchor was found by content search near offset 1002002
